cues.text: Three shots. Cover, frame one, no host: the real reply card, "REAL REPLY: GEMINI 3.8 FLASH (API)", "NOV 1, 2026", the four quote lines and the railing line lit red; plate "Make AI flag / what you never priced.". On "railing" cut in close on the flagged line, big. On "painted" cut to the living room: the stair railing, a brush, a price tag reading $0 swinging; "PAINTED FOR FREE?"; Snow comes in.
Back to the reply card; FLAGGED stamps on the railing line; "NO PRICE GUESSED" under it.
The slot machine: AI PRICES, reels spinning question marks.
The reels stop left to right on L, I, S, T; label "IT STUCK TO YOUR LIST".
"What happens to / the railing?" lands in the crown.
Painter one's kitchen table at night (EXAMPLE): clock 10 PM, a laptop, the quote typing from memory: Walls, Ceiling, Doors, Patch. No railing.
FREE WORK stamps in red across the quote; Snow shrugs.
The street: painter two's van drives and parks in the driveway on "driveway"; in the sky a phone note, MY PRICES: Walls, Ceiling, Door, Patch, each [my price].
The note gets the prompt on top and NOTES under it; a PASTE INTO GEMINI arrow.
The tool belt (the metaphor): MY PRICE LIST, four items (Walls, Ceiling, Door, Patch), the cursor steps through them; footer USE ONLY MY LIST.
Mosaic into the real reply card, word for word: four lines, then FLAGGED ITEM, the railing line lit red; FLAGGED stamps on "flagged".

Gemini's own plan page, Free, $0/ month with a Google Account, tag "gemini.google/subscriptions, Nov 1, 2026"; then the setup card (ITEM GET, SETUP 4 STEPS) slides in: the four steps, held, the hand cursor stepping down.
The boss: FREE WORK, full HP. Hits on "list" (MY LIST), "job" (QUOTE LINES), "price" (I PRICE IT); it breaks on "railing", PAID stamps. Then the end card with the send line.
